scope: Optional presentation and native reference app composition of document, passport and biometric capabilities; headless SDK packages remain independently consumable.

reference-apps/ios/Sources/FaceCompariso: "Unthresholded cosine similarity; larger values indicate closer embedding direction."
reference-apps/ios/Sources/PassportCaptu: "CREATE TABLE comparison_snapshot( operation_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL REFERENCES face_capture(operation_id), payload_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(payload_sha256)=64), payload BLOB NOT NULL CHECK(length(payload)>0 AND length(payload)<=9437184) ) STRICT"

"CREATE TABLE face_capture( operation_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL CHECK(length(operation_id)=36), workflow_id TEXT CHECK(workflow_id IS NULL OR length(workflow_id)=36), recorded_at_ms INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(recorded_at_ms>0), reference_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(reference_sha256)=64), selfie_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(selfie_sha256)=64), payload_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(payload_sha256)=64), payload BLOB NOT NULL CHECK(length(payload)>0 AND length(payload)<=41943040) ) STRICT"

"CREATE TABLE face_stage( stage_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL CHECK(length(stage_id)=36), operation_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES face_capture(operation_id), engine TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(engine IN ('aura','liquid')), sequence INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(sequence>0), recorded_at_ms INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(recorded_at_ms>0), preceding_aura_id TEXT REFERENCES face_stage(stage_id), payload_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(payload_sha256)=64), payload BLOB NOT NULL CHECK(length(payload)>0 AND length(payload)<=1048576), UNIQUE(operation_id,engine,sequence) ) STRICT"

"CREATE TABLE liquid_pass_event( event_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL CHECK(length(event_id)=36), attempt_id TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(attempt_id)=36), operation_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES face_capture(operation_id), aura_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES face_stage(stage_id), pass TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(pass IN ('quality','comparison','presentation')), status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(status IN ('pending','completed','failed')), recorded_at_ms INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(recorded_at_ms>0), payload_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(payload_sha256)=64), payload BLOB NOT NULL CHECK(length(payload)>0 AND length(payload)<=65536), UNIQUE(attempt_id,status) ) STRICT"

"CREATE TABLE passport_checkpoint( slot INTEGER PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL CHECK(slot = 1), capture_id TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL CHECK(length(capture_id) = 36), captured_at_ms INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(captured_at_ms > 0), verification_scope TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(verification_scope = 'local_nfc'), payload_version INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(payload_version = 1), payload_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(payload_sha256) = 64), portrait_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(portrait_sha256) = 64), sod_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(sod_sha256) = 64), payload BLOB NOT NULL CHECK(length(payload) > 0 AND length(payload) <= 20971520) ) STRICT"

"CREATE TABLE passport_schema_migrations( version INTEGER PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL CHECK(version > 0), migration_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(migration_sha256) = 64), applied_at_ms INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(applied_at_ms > 0) ) STRICT"

"CREATE TABLE workflow_event( event_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL CHECK(length(event_id)=36), workflow_id TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(workflow_id)=36), sequence INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(sequence>0), occurred_at_ms INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(occurred_at_ms>0), action TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(action)>0 AND length(action)<=128), payload_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(payload_sha256)=64), payload BLOB NOT NULL CHECK(length(payload)>0 AND length(payload)<=262144), UNIQUE(workflow_id,sequence) ) STRICT"
"INSERT INTO liquid_pass_event_v4 SELECT * FROM liquid_pass_event ORDER BY rowid"
"SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT * FROM liquid_pass_event EXCEPT SELECT * FROM liquid_pass_event_v4)"
"SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT * FROM liquid_pass_event_v4 EXCEPT SELECT * FROM liquid_pass_event)"
"SELECT count(*) FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' AND name NOT GLOB '_kenshiki_*' AND name NOT GLOB 'sqlite_*'"
"SELECT sql FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' AND name='passport_checkpoint'"
"SELECT sql FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' AND name='passport_schema_migrations'"
"INSERT INTO face_stage SELECT ?,?,?,COALESCE(max(sequence),0)+1,?,?,?,? FROM face_stage WHERE operation_id=? AND engine=?"

"INSERT INTO passport_checkpoint(slot, capture_id, captured_at_ms, verification_scope, payload_version, payload_sha256, portrait_sha256, sod_sha256, payload) VALUES(1, ?, ?, 'local_nfc', 1, ?, ?, ?, ?) ON CONFLICT(slot) DO UPDATE SET capture_id=excluded.capture_id, captured_at_ms=excluded.captured_at_ms, payload_sha256=excluded.payload_sha256, portrait_sha256=excluded.portrait_sha256, sod_sha256=excluded.sod_sha256, payload=excluded.payload"
"INSERT INTO workflow_event SELECT ?,?,COALESCE(max(sequence),0)+1,?,?,?,? FROM workflow_event WHERE workflow_id=?"
"SELECT count(*) FROM face_stage WHERE stage_id=? AND operation_id=? AND engine='aura'"

"SELECT count(*) FROM liquid_pass_event AS p WHERE p.status='pending' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM liquid_pass_event AS t WHERE t.attempt_id=p.attempt_id AND t.operation_id=p.operation_id AND t.status IN ('completed','failed'))"
"SELECT operation_id FROM face_capture ORDER BY rowid DESC LIMIT 1"
"SELECT payload, payload_sha256, capture_id, captured_at_ms, portrait_sha256, sod_sha256 FROM passport_checkpoint WHERE slot = 1"
"SELECT payload,payload_sha256,event_id,attempt_id,aura_id,pass,status,recorded_at_ms FROM liquid_pass_event WHERE operation_id=? ORDER BY rowid"
"SELECT payload,payload_sha256,event_id,sequence,occurred_at_ms,action FROM workflow_event WHERE workflow_id=? AND sequence<=? ORDER BY sequence"
"SELECT payload,payload_sha256,event_id,sequence,occurred_at_ms,action FROM workflow_event WHERE workflow_id=? AND sequence>? ORDER BY sequence LIMIT 256"
"SELECT payload,payload_sha256,event_id,sequence,occurred_at_ms,action FROM workflow_event WHERE workflow_id=? ORDER BY sequence LIMIT ?"
"SELECT payload,payload_sha256,event_id,workflow_id FROM workflow_event WHERE action='passport.mrz.captured' ORDER BY rowid DESC LIMIT 1"
"SELECT payload,payload_sha256,stage_id,preceding_aura_id,recorded_at_ms FROM face_stage WHERE operation_id=? AND engine=? ORDER BY sequence DESC LIMIT 1"
